title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues the systematic tabulation begun on the previous page. Its context is Teichmüller theory in genus 1, one-holed or one-punctured. H is a group generated by ε0 and ε1 subject to the braid relation ε0ε1ε0 = ε1ε0ε1. That makes H a quotient of the Artin braid group B3. B3 is the universal central extension of PSL2(Z) and covers SL2(Z); ε0 and ε1 are the Dehn twists along two simple closed curves meeting once. Derived elements: σ = ε0ε1ε0 (Garside Δ, lifting the order-4 element S); ρ0 = (ε1ε0)^{-1} and ρ1 = (ε0ε1)^{-1} (lifting order-6 elements); ρ'_i = ρ_i^{-2} (lifting order-3 elements); ω = σ^2 = ρ_i^{-3} (central, lifting -I). Grothendieck lists, for each 'natural' pair of generators, the other elements in terms of the pair and the defining relations in that pair, with symmetric versions under ε0 ↔ ε1.

(e) Pair (ε0, ε1): the fundamental braid relation, also written as a single relator.

(f0) Pair (σ, ε0): ε1 = σε0σ^{-1}, ρ0 = σ^{-1}ε0, ρ'0 = σε0, ρ1 = ε0σ^{-1}, ρ'1 = ε0σ. Relations: [σ^2, ε0] = 1 and (σ^{-1}ε0)^3 = σ^{-2}. Equivalently, with x = σ and y = σ^{-1}ε0, this is y^3 = x^{-2}, i.e. the trefoil presentation <x, y | x^2 = y^3> up to inversion.

(g0) Pair (σ, ρ0): ε0 = σρ0, ε1 = ρ0σ, ρ'0 = ρ0^{-2}, ρ1 = σρ0σ^{-1}, ρ'1 = σρ0^{-2}σ^{-1}. The single relation ρ0^{-3} = σ^2 = ω is noted as a central element. This is exactly the classical presentation B3 = <a, b | a^2 = b^3>.

(g'0) Pair (σ, ρ'0): ε0 = σ^{-1}ρ'0, ε1 = ρ'0σ^{-1}, ρ0 = σ^{-2}ρ'0, ρ1 = σ^{-1}ρ'0σ^{-1}, ρ'1 = σρ'0σ^{-1}. Relations: [σ^2, ρ'0] = 1 and ρ'0^3 = σ^4. Here the commutation is genuinely needed, since ρ'^3 = σ^4 alone only makes σ^4 central.

(h0) Pair (ε0, ρ0): ε1 = ρ0ε0ρ0^{-1}, σ = ε0ρ0^{-1}, ρ'0 = ρ0^{-2}, ρ1 = ε0ρ0ε0^{-1}, ρ'1 = ε0ρ0^{-2}ε0^{-1}. There is a single relator ρ0ε0ρ0^{-1}ε0ρ0 = 1, i.e. ε1ε0 = ρ0^{-1} with ε1 defined by conjugation.

I verified each formula and each presentation: each pair generates and the boxed relations define B3 (or H as its quotient). The purpose is evidently a 'formulaire' for the basic genus-1 building block of the Teichmüller tower (Γ_{1,1}, Γ_{1,1}^{(boundary)}). This block is needed to write generators and relations of the tower in all its avatars, e.g. in terms of rotations (finite-order elements) versus Dehn twists. The next page continues with the pairs (ε0, ρ'0) and (ε0, ρ1), and a further pair (ε0, ρ'1).
errors: The machine transcription of the g0 box reads ρ0^{-3} = σ^{-2}; mathematically it must be ρ0^{-3} = σ^2 = ω, consistent with page 35 (c), since ρ0^{-3} = (ε1ε0)^3 = Δ^2 = σ^2. The image should be read as σ^2, or else it is a slip of the pen.
In (f0) the relation [σ^2, ε0] = 1 is redundant: it follows from (σ^{-1}ε0)^3 = σ^{-2}, because σ^{-2} is then a power of ρ0 = σ^{-1}ε0 and commutes with σ. Correct but non-minimal.
Minor: the (g'0) line 'ρ1 = σ^{-1}ρ'0σ^{-1} =' is left unfinished (no harm).

ideas.what: Braid relation on two Dehn twists; σ = ε0ε1ε0 as Garside element with σ^2 central
ideas.modern_name: Artin braid group B3 / Garside element Δ, Δ^2 generating the centre
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses Γ_{1,1}, SL2(Z) and the 'Lego' of the Teichmüller tower, but not this explicit formulaire

ideas.what: Presentation in (σ, ρ0) with single relation ρ0^{-3} = σ^2
ideas.modern_name: B3 ≅ <a, b | a^2 = b^3> (trefoil knot group), universal central extension of PSL2(Z) = Z/2 * Z/3

ideas.what: Presentations of B3 in the pairs (σ, ε0), (σ, ρ'0), (ε0, ρ0): a one-relator presentation ρ0ε0ρ0^{-1}ε0ρ0 = 1, and a two-relator one [σ^2, ρ'] = 1, ρ'^3 = σ^4
ideas.modern_name: alternative presentations of B3 / of the genus-1 mapping class group with boundary, mixing Dehn twists and torsion lifts

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but routine bookkeeping of presentations of B3 (the genus-1 building block of the Teichmüller tower) in various generator pairs. Everything is classical, and no new connection or result appears on this page.
transcription_corrections: Box in (g0): should read ρ0^{-3} = σ^2 (underbrace ω), not σ^{-2}; the marginal note reads 'élément inv. central' after striking out 'élément central'.
In (f0) the second boxed relation is (σ^{-1}ε0)^3 = σ^{-2}; the exponent was corrected in the manuscript.
The phrase after (g'0) probably reads 'Symétriques pour expressions en σ, ρ'1 (relations g'1)' rather than 'ρ1, ρ'1'.
The phrase after (g0) reads 'Symétriques pour expressions en σ, ρ1 (relations g1)'.
